## ARRAY_AGG with INTERVAL values
# Sources: BigQuery's aggregate_functions#array_agg, for IGNORE NULLS, ORDER BY, LIMIT and NULL
# for no input; ORDER BY compares lengths, with 30 days to a month, as GoogleSQL's
# compliance/testdata/interval.test (orderby) does. BigQuery's answers for the INTERVAL keys and
# values it orders, which exclude INTERVAL values ordered by themselves alone, and for DISTINCT.

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL '1-2 3 4:5:6.789' YEAR TO SECOND]) AS i
=> [{"v":"1-2 3 4:5:6.789"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY n)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> [{"v":"0-0 40 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-1 0 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-0 0 2:0:0"}]

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(n ORDER BY i))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "[3,2,1]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(n ORDER BY i DESC LIMIT 2))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 2 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 40 DAY)])
=> "[3,2]"

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i IGNORE NULLS ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 2)
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS i), (2, NULL), (3, INTERVAL 1 DAY), (4, INTERVAL 2 DAY)])
=> [{"v":"0-0 2 0:0:0"},{"v":"0-0 1 0:0:0"}]

SELECT ARRAY_AGG(i) IS NULL FROM UNNEST(CAST([] AS ARRAY<INTERVAL>)) AS i
=> "true"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY j))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i, INTERVAL 3 DAY AS j), (INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 1 DAY)])
=> "[\"P1M\",\"P40D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY n, i))
FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (1, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (0, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
=> "[\"PT2H\",\"P1M\",\"P40D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(i ORDER BY i))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 40 DAY, INTERVAL -1 SECOND, INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 2 HOUR]) AS i
=> error contains: Unsupported type INTERVAL for array_agg.

SELECT STRING_AGG(TO_JSON_STRING(a), ' ' ORDER BY k) FROM (
  SELECT k, ARRAY_AGG(i) OVER (ORDER BY k ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS k, INTERVAL 1 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL -2 HOUR)])
)
=> "[\"P1D\"] [\"P1D\",\"P1M\"] [\"P1M\",\"PT-2H\"]"

SELECT STRING_AGG(TO_JSON_STRING(a), ' ' ORDER BY n) FROM (
  SELECT n, ARRAY_AGG(i) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS a
  FROM UNNEST([STRUCT(1 AS n, INTERVAL 40 DAY AS i), (2, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), (3, INTERVAL 2 HOUR)])
)
=> "[\"PT2H\",\"P1M\",\"P40D\"] [\"PT2H\",\"P1M\"] [\"PT2H\"]"

# DISTINCT keeps the first of equal values in input order, LIMIT takes the first of those, and
# BigQuery rejects DISTINCT with ORDER BY.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i)) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 30 DAY, INTERVAL 1 MONTH]) AS i
=> "[\"P30D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i)) FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 30 DAY]) AS i
=> "[\"P1M\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 24 HOUR, INTERVAL 30 DAY]) AS i
=> "[\"P1M\",\"P1D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i IGNORE NULLS)) FROM UNNEST([NULL, INTERVAL 1 DAY, NULL]) AS i
=> "[\"P1D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i LIMIT 2))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 30 DAY, INTERVAL 1 DAY]) AS i
=> "[\"P1M\",\"P1D\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT i ORDER BY i))
FROM UNNEST([INTERVAL 1 MONTH, INTERVAL 1 DAY, INTERVAL 720 HOUR, INTERVAL 30 DAY]) AS i
=> error contains: Unsupported type INTERVAL for array_agg.
